verdict.rationale: Weave's own marketing and docs describe background automation: built-in and custom signals automatically capture and classify agent interactions, and alerts send Slack notifications and trigger webhook automations. The evidence is mostly marketing-level, with no detail on how to configure an automation, what triggers or schedules exist, or what actions are available beyond webhooks. The autonomous iteration loops in docs-20 and docs-43 are run by external coding agents connecting through MCP, so they do not count as Weave's own automations. Missing for 10: documented automation configuration (triggers, conditions, schedules), detail on the actions an automation can take, docs for scheduled or background evaluation runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
